verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an MCP *server* that lets external clients like Claude/Cursor connect to Bolna (bolna-docs-17, bolna-docs-25, bolna-probe-3), which is the reverse direction of the story — it does not show Bolna itself acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers so its voice agents can use their tools. No evidence describes Bolna consuming external MCP servers.
